campbell.title: Campbell City Council — September 15, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council agenda for September 15, 2026 includes a proposed update to the city's theater use policy, a cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose for resurfacing work, and an annual update to the city's investment policy. The agenda also lists a budget adjustment related to replacing remaining equipment or infrastructure, though full details on that item are not available.
keyTopics: Proposed modification to Council Policy Section 14 (Theater Use Policy), effective September 16th, with a staff presentation from the Recreation and Community department
Cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose, not to exceed $335,000, for resurfacing work
Resolution approving the annual update to the city's investment policy for fiscal year 2026-27
Resolution authorizing a budget adjustment to fund replacement of remaining equipment

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — September 16, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council's September 16, 2026 agenda includes routine approvals (minutes, check registers, a conflict-of-interest code update) along with two final map approvals for lot splits. The agenda also lists two appeal hearings on planning decisions and a discussion on law enforcement service options ahead of upcoming town hall meetings.
keyTopics: Final map approvals for lot splits at 20517 Carniel Avenue and 19351 Saratoga Los Gatos Road
Appeal of Planning Commission approval of a Design Review and setback variance for a home and ADU at 14650 6th Street
Appeal of Planning Commission approval of a three-lot subdivision at 14486 Oak Place
Discussion of law enforcement service options ahead of September 19 and September 30 town hall meetings
Resolution amending the City's Conflict of Interest Code

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — September 22, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council agenda for September 22, 2026, included routine items like approving prior meeting minutes and a wastewater treatment plant agreement, along with an interim urgency ordinance establishing a temporary moratorium on detention or custodial facility applications. The agenda also listed commission appointments, a legal services contract amendment, and extending a councilmember's regional transit board role.
keyTopics: Interim urgency ordinance proposing a temporary moratorium on applications for detention or custodial facilities and custodial-processing facilities
Resolution to authorize Addendum No. 14 to the Regional Water Quality Control Plant Basic Agreement with Palo Alto and Mountain View
Appointment of Councilmember Jonathan D. Weinberg to an additional two-year term on the VTA Board representing north counties
Appointments to the Complete Streets Commission, Environmental Commission, and Planning Commission
Amendment No. 1 to the legal services agreement with Berliner Cohen, LLP, updating the monthly retainer to $21,500 for up to 70 hours plus a $385 hourly rate

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — September 15, 2026
los-gatos.summary: This Los Gatos Town Council agenda covers routine business, including approval of minutes from prior meetings and a monthly financial and investment report for July 2026. It also lists several contract actions, including amendments to existing agreements and new professional services agreements the Town Manager would be authorized to execute.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from the September 1, 2026 Closed Session and regular Town Council meetings
Monthly Financial and Investment Report for July 2026 (with a correction noted)
A second amendment to an existing agreement
A first amendment to a Heating Ventilation and Air (HVAC) agreement
New professional services agreements for the Town Manager to execute

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — September 30, 2026
san-jose.summary: This is a San José City Council Rules and Open Government Committee agenda covering routine agenda-setting for upcoming October meetings, plus several special event approvals and policy items. The agenda lists proposed discussions on special event funding for events sponsored by Councilmembers, a flag-raising ceremony, and multiple proposals related to license plate reader data safeguards and council transparency agreements.
keyTopics: Approval of 'Free Use' of the Janet Gray Hayes Rotunda for Councilmember Mulcahy's 'Conversations for Good 2026' event
Approval of the District 9 End-of-Term Farewell Celebration as a City Council sponsored special event
Retroactive approval of the Golden State Valkyries flag raising sponsored by Mayor Mahan's office
Proposals on Council Transparency and Private Non-Disclosure Agreements
Multiple proposals on Automated License Plate Reader data access, internal controls, and safeguards

mountain-view.title: Mountain View Council Sustainability Committee — September 29, 2026
mountain-view.summary: This Mountain View Council Sustainability Committee agenda covers the city's draft Five-Year Community Decarbonization Plan and the 2024 Community Greenhouse Gas Emissions Inventory. It also includes standard time for public comment and committee/staff discussion items.
keyTopics: Draft Five-Year Community Decarbonization Plan
2024 Community Greenhouse Gas Emissions Inventory

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — September 29, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council agenda for September 29, 2026 includes several contracts and budget items—covering recreation software, video conferencing equipment, power supply upgrades, and a maintenance management system—along with a reimbursement agreement with VTA for water facility relocation tied to the US 101 Express Lanes Project. The agenda also lists adoption of the Sunnyvale Homelessness Response Plan as a five-year framework, plus recognitions for Filipino American History Month, Hindu American Heritage Month, and Domestic Violence Awareness Month.
keyTopics: Adoption of the Sunnyvale Homelessness Response Plan as a five-year framework, with a community outreach update
Contract awards for recreation management software, City Hall video conferencing equipment, UPS upgrades, and a computerized maintenance management system
Reimbursement agreement with VTA for relocating city water facilities for the US 101 Express Lanes Project, including a $300,000 budget modification
Side letter agreement with the Public Safety Officers Association adding special assignment pay for the new Community Crime Reduction Team
Adoption of city positions on state and local ballot measures for the November 3, 2026 election

cupertino.title: Cupertino Parks and Recreation Commission — October 1, 2026
cupertino.summary: The October 1 agenda for Cupertino's Parks and Recreation Commission listed an item from the Parks and Recreation Department's Youth/Teen/Events/Facilities Division, approval of September 3 meeting minutes, and future agenda setting.
keyTopics: Parks and Recreation Department Youth/Teen/Events/Facilities Division
Approval of September 3, 2026 Parks and Recreation Commission meeting minutes
Upcoming draft agenda items

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — September 22, 2026
santa-clara.summary: The Santa Clara City Council's agenda for this meeting includes a public hearing on a proposed housing development at 451-475 El Camino Real, which would involve annexing the land into the city, rezoning it, and approving plans for 408 new homes. The agenda also lists closed-session discussions on existing and anticipated legal matters, including a case involving the city's power utility and the state's Department of Water Resources.
keyTopics: Public hearing on prezoning, land use designation, annexation, and a subdivision map to allow 408 residential units at 451-475 El Camino Real, with an Environmental Impact Report prepared under CEQA
Closed-session discussion on existing litigation: City of Santa Clara (Silicon Valley Power) and Northern California Power Agency vs. California Department of Water Resources
Closed-session discussion on anticipated litigation involving one potential case

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 15, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council agenda for September 15, 2026 covers a mix of financial and infrastructure items, including a federal housing and community development grant plan, a review of red light camera traffic safety efforts, and an assessment of the Milpitas Community Center's physical condition. The agenda also lists resolutions related to the city's former redevelopment agency finances, including a bond refinancing action.
keyTopics: Draft Program Year 2025 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Plan
Presentation on the Red Light Camera Traffic Safety Program
Presentation on the condition of the Milpitas Community Center
Resolution of the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency board
Resolution authorizing sale and issuance of refunding bonds for the Successor Agency

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Parks and Recreation Commission — September 22, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto Parks and Recreation Commission's agenda for this meeting covers a council liaison update, a department staff report, and updates from ad hoc committees. The main discussion items listed are proposed guidelines for synthetic turf use on playgrounds and a park improvements ordinance recommendation for the Foothills Nature Preserve Improvement Project.
keyTopics: Proposed Playground Synthetic Turf Use Guidelines
Park Improvements Ordinance recommendation for the Foothills Nature Preserve Improvement Project (PE-21000)
Department staff presentation/report
Ad hoc committee and liaison updates
